snippet.title: Rainbow Six Tactics: Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Get your first look at Rainbow Six Tactics: a brand-new single-player Rainbow Six game, featuring Siege operators and turn-based gameplay.

Wishlist now (Ubisoft Store): https://rainbowsixtactics.com/store
Wishlist now (Steam): https://store.steampowered.com/app/3621390

Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics is a single player tactical game set in the Rainbow Six universe. Command elite operators in tense turn based battles, breach through destructible environments, and outsmart enemies with synchronized assaults. Upgrade your HQ between missions to unlock new skills, new gear, and gather clues to unravel a global conspiracy.

#Ubisoft #RainbowSix

Learn more about Ubisoft: www.ubisoftgroup.com
